# EMEA Data Governance Policy

## 1. Purpose
Defines the policy requirements for emea data governance policy across EMEA entities.

## 2. Scope
All EMEA legal entities, employees, contractors and third parties processing firm data.

- Exceptions require documented approval by the policy owner.
- Compliance is monitored through automated controls in EMEA Guard.
